title: Present Perfect basics
explanationRu: Present Perfect связывает прошлый опыт с настоящим: have/has + past participle. Для интервью особенно полезна конструкция I have worked with... и вопросы Have you ever...?. Не используем Present Perfect с конкретным законченным временем вроде yesterday.

examples.en: I have worked with Linux for several years.
examples.ru: Я работаю с Linux уже несколько лет.

examples.en: I have never used Kubernetes in production.
examples.ru: Я никогда не использовал Kubernetes в production.

exercises.question: Have you ever ___ this tool?
exercises.explanation: После have нужен past participle: used.

exercises.question: I have never ___ Kubernetes in production. (use)
Я раньше работал с FastAPI.
acceptedAnswers: I have worked with FastAPI before.
exercises.explanation: Опыт без конкретного времени: Present Perfect.

acceptedAnswers: I have never worked with this directly.
